claims.statement: Molecular Graph Neural Networks are applied in drug discovery.

The integration of artificial intelligence (AI) in drug discovery has profoundly transformed the pharmaceutical landscape by significantly accelerating the identification of potential drug candidates.
Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have proven to be particularly effective in modeling molecular structures, optimizing drug-target interactions, and enhancing prediction accuracy.
GNNs offer advantages compared to traditional molecular representations.
Graph neural networks can be used for drug discovery, with established protocols and applications.
Graph Neural Networks can be used for drug discovery.
An integrated decision support pipeline based on Graph Neural Networks has been created for drug discovery.
Graph neural networks can be used for automated de novo drug design.
